input.question: Are musicians brains "wired" differently than non-musicians?
input.ground_truth: A well-trained musician can hear notes and different types of instruments in pieces. They study music and can decipher music regularly. I would say anyone can learn music and be able to create a song if you learn the foundations of music.

Explain the following question in a simple way as if you are explaining to a 5-year-old.

Question: Are musicians brains "wired" differently than non-musicians?

Answer:

response.prediction:
Sure! Here’s how I’d explain it to a 5-year-old:

When people practice music a lot, their brains get really good at listening and making music. It’s kind of like how practicing running makes your legs stronger. So, the parts of the brain that help with music can get extra practice and become really good at it. That’s why some people who play music a lot might have their brains a little bit different from people who don’t play music. But everyone’s brain is special in its own way!
